does: Presses water out of a block of firm tofu under a light weight, so that it is firmer, absorbs a sauce and browns instead of steaming.
how: Wrap the block in a clean cloth or paper towels.
Set it on a tray or a board, put a plate and a light weight on top and tilt the tray so the water runs off.
Leave it until the water has stopped running out.

cues.text: The cloth is wet and the block has become a little thinner.
The tofu is firm and springs back.

mistakes.mistake: Pressing with a heavy weight, which cracks the block.
mistakes.fix: Use a plate or a light bowl only.

mistakes.mistake: Skipping the drying, so that the tofu spits in the pan.
